64:10.text: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

64:11.text: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

64:12.text: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only

64:13.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

64:14.text: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

64:15.text: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.

64:16.text: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend
; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

64:17.text: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is

64:18.text: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
